page.overview:
Who is Fishman?

Fishmen appear in as supporting characters that help Link by giving him tips about secrets across the Great Sea and filling out sections of his Sea Chart.

Fishmen know much about the Great Sea and will give Link many tips and words of knowledge about everything. They are also great cartographers and will fill in portions of the Sea Chart for Link in exchange for All-Purpose Bait.

After obtaining the Bow, Link can play a minigame with them to help relieve their body aches. The Fishman will jump out of the water 10 times, so Link must shoot it with Arrows. The reward for this is 10 Rupees for every successful hit and 200 Rupees for a perfect score. These Arrows remain stuck in the Fishman's body after the completion of the game.

One of these Fishmen associated regularly with the Cafe worker Gillian. Loot, another resident of Windfall Island, is afraid of Fishmen.
